type_constraints.description: vectorIndexType must be one of allowed index types
properties[].tokenization must be a valid enum value
type_constraints.assertion: properties.properties[].tokenization in {word, lowercase, whitespace, field, trigram, gse, kagome_kr, kagome_ja, gse_ch}

type_constraints.description: id field must be valid UUID format
type_constraints.assertion: body.id is null OR matches UUID format

type_constraints.description: vector takes precedence over vectorizer module
type_constraints.assertion: if body.vector provided, it overrides vectorizer-generated vector

type_constraints.description: from beacon format must include className/uuid/propertyName

type_constraints.assertion: query string case must match schema exactly

type_constraints.description: Tenant.activityStatus on create must be ACTIVE or INACTIVE
Tenant.activityStatus on update must be ACTIVE, INACTIVE, or OFFLOADED
backup id must be URL-safe (lowercase, numbers, underscore, minus only)
config.CompressionLevel must be a valid enum
type_constraints.assertion: config.CompressionLevel in {DefaultCompression, BestSpeed, BestCompression, ZstdDefaultCompression, ZstdBestSpeed, ZstdBestCompression, NoCompression}

type_constraints.description: namespace name must be lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; 3-36 chars; start/end with letter or digit
searchable.algorithm must be blockmax (WAND->BlockMax migration only; downgrade rejected)

range_constraints.description: max deletions per request is QUERY_MAXIMUM_RESULTS (default 10000)
integer GraphQL fields only support int32 (not int64)
range_constraints.assertion: integer values in GraphQL must fit int32 range [-2147483648, 2147483647]

state_constraints.description: after cursor is mutually exclusive with offset and sort
state_constraints.assertion: (after provided) implies (offset == 0 and sort not provided)

state_constraints.description: batch is idempotent by UUID; existing UUIDs are overwritten (PUT semantics per item)
state_constraints.assertion: POST /batch/objects with existing UUID overwrites rather than errors

state_constraints.description: POST fails if id already exists; use PUT/PATCH to update
state_constraints.assertion: POST /objects returns error if id exists; PUT/PATCH required to update

state_constraints.description: include and exclude are mutually exclusive
target cluster must have same node count and node names as source
collections must not already exist on target cluster
state_constraints.assertion: for each collection in backup, NOT exists(collection) on target

state_constraints.description: deleting a collection permanently deletes all data objects in the collection
deleting tenants permanently deletes all tenant data
state_constraints.assertion: after DELETE tenants, GET tenant returns 404 and its data is gone

state_constraints.description: PUT does NOT add properties (use POST /schema/{className}/properties) and does NOT rename
state_constraints.assertion: PUT /schema/{className} does not change properties count or names

state_constraints.description: index update triggers async reindex (202); 409 if conflicting reindex running; 503 if distributed tasks disabled

assertions.description: creating collection with disallowed vectorIndexType returns 422 RestrictionViolationResponse
assertions.expected_behavior: 422 with errorCode CONFIG_NOT_ALLOWED and restriction vector_index_type

assertions.description: exceeding collections/shards usage limit returns 429 UsageLimitExceededResponse
assertions.expected_behavior: 429 with errorCode USAGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED and limit collections|shards

assertions.description: POST with existing id fails; should return error not overwrite
assertions.expected_behavior: error response (not 200 overwrite); use PUT/PATCH to update

assertions.description: exceeding object count usage limit returns 429
usage limit exceeded rejects WHOLE BATCH (no partial fill)
assertions.expected_behavior: 429 with all objects FAILED; no partial success

assertions.description: successful response returns per-object result with SUCCESS/FAILED status
assertions.expected_behavior: 200 with array of ObjectsGetResponse each containing result.status

assertions.description: adding reference to non-reference property returns 422
downgrading from blockmax algorithm is rejected
backup status transitions STARTED -> TRANSFERRING -> TRANSFERRED -> FINALIZING -> SUCCESS
assertions.expected_behavior: BackupCreateResponse status follows enum progression; FAILED/CANCELED are terminal

assertions.description: large integer values (>int32) cannot be passed in GraphQL int fields; string workaround required
assertions.expected_behavior: integer values outside int32 range are not representable; pass as string

assertions.description: exceeding tenant usage limit returns 429 with limit: tenants
namespace deletion is async; returns 202 immediately
PATCH only modifies provided fields (RFC 7396 JSON merge)
assertions.expected_behavior: fields not in patch body remain unchanged

behavioral_contracts.scenario: POST /objects creates object; subsequent GET /objects/{className}/{id} returns it
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: after 200 from POST, GET returns 200 with the created object (subject to consistency_level)

behavioral_contracts.description: Deleted object is no longer queryable
PUT replaces object atomically; schema-validated; lastUpdateTimeUnix updated
behavioral_contracts.scenario: PUT /objects/{className}/{id} with full body; GET returns new values
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: after 200, GET reflects all new field values; invalid schema returns 422 (no partial update)

behavioral_contracts.description: Deleting a collection cascades to all its objects
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: after DELETE, collection and all objects gone; GET /schema/{className} returns 404

behavioral_contracts.description: Batch create is idempotent on UUID (PUT semantics per item)
behavioral_contracts.scenario: POST /batch/objects twice with same UUID; second call overwrites first
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: no error on duplicate UUID; object is overwritten; both return 200

state_invariants.description: A created collection is queryable via GET /schema/{className}
A deleted collection is no longer queryable
Inserting N objects into a collection increments its object count by N
state_invariants.assertion: after inserting N objects, GET /nodes/{className} reports count increased by N

state_invariants.description: Objects of different tenants in same multi-tenant collection are isolated
state_invariants.assertion: GET /objects?tenant=A does not return objects inserted with tenant=B

state_invariants.description: A deleted object is no longer queryable
